confirmed_initial_finding.description: Bazel 9 run rejects test targets with multiple status artifacts. The original state-unit-tests target has four shards, so listing it with plain bazel run would fail before producing the actual inventory.
confirmed_initial_finding.resolution: Exactly the inventory and ignored-inventory bazel run commands now set --test_sharding_strategy=disabled. The original test command retains four state shards.

checks: The two listing commands are the only new --test_sharding_strategy=disabled occurrences.
Original three-target test argv and scoped Clippy argv remain byte-identical.
The reader still requires fresh expected shard paths, complete original case identities, deterministic FNV partitioning, no duplicates, no retries and the exact original ignored cases.
Actual executable listing is forwarded by the existing launcher as --list/--ignored; listing does not execute test cases.
conclusion: No additional confirmed blocking issue in the reviewed narrow successor. Initial reader remains unexecuted HOLD; new controls and native qualification are required.
